$comment: The decisions a rule could not make, one line each, so that a reviewer can disagree
with a single food instead of with the whole pipeline. Everything else in the subset
comes from subset.rules.json applied to the whole table.
`keep` forces a food in even where a rule would have removed it, and exempts it from
clustering and from the per-food cap. `drop` forces one out. Both are counted
separately in the build report, so the number of hand decisions is itself reviewable
and can be watched for growth: a rules file that needs fifty overrides is a rules
Every entry here exists for the same reason. The clustering pass asks whether two
rows differ nutritionally; it cannot ask which of two nutritionally identical rows a
person would search for. Ciqual has no popularity column, so where the mechanical
representative is the obscure one, it is named here.

keep.note: Rice, wholegrain, raw. Clusters into 'Rice, red, raw', which has the same figures and a fraction of the readers. PRD_FOOD 9.5 names this exact split as justified: 'riz blanc et riz complet n'ont pas les memes fibres'.

Lentil, pink or red, dried. Clusters into 'Lentil, dried (average)'. Kept because PRD_FOOD 8.6's cooked-ratio table names red lentils specifically, and a reader checking that row must be able to find it.
Salmon, raw, farmed. Sub-group 0406 clusters whole (108 species, one set of numbers), and the mechanical representative is not salmon. Salmon is the fish people log.
Salmon, smoked. Same reason, and its salt and fat put it far from raw salmon anyway.
Tuna, raw. Same reason as salmon: the second fish anyone searches for.
Chick pea, dried. Clusters into another dried pulse with the same figures; chickpeas are eaten far more often than whichever row won.
Chick pea, boiled/cooked in water. The state chickpeas are actually eaten in.
Cheddar cheese, from cow's milk. Sub-group 0503 clusters by kind, and hard cheeses are nutritionally interchangeable; cheddar is the one an English-language app must have.

Chicken, breast, without skin, raw. Sub-group 0402 clusters by kind and the mechanical representative of poultry is a whole-bird average; PRD_FOOD 8.6's cooked-ratio table names chicken breast, and the row that carries the 0.766 ratio has to be findable.
Rice, white, raw. Survives on its own today, but it carries PRD_FOOD 8.6's flagship ratio and no rule change should be allowed to remove it quietly.
Pasta, dry, regular, raw. Same reason: it carries the 2.19 pasta ratio PRD_FOOD 8.6 names.
